cpu: AMD Ryzen 5 PRO 4650G with Radeon Graphics
clang:
Ubuntu clang version 18.1.3 (1ubuntu1)
Target: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /usr/bin
timing: hrtime around Compiler_Session::compile; includes tool probes, native object compilation and linking; excludes bootstrap, fixture copies, counters, exports and executable verification
memory: PHP allocator peak per phase, reset before compile; includes live resident snapshots, excludes external Clang/linker memory

tool_measurement.wall_time: perf_counter around each real Clang invocation, excluding Python wrapper startup
tool_measurement.cpu_time: Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN user/system CPU for the single invocation and waited descendants
tool_measurement.memory: Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss * 1024 bytes: largest process RSS high-water within an invocation, including waited descendants; not simultaneous process-tree total
tool_measurement.link_scope: Clang link-driver invocation including the real linker; not linker-only isolation
tool_measurement.wrapper: fresh Python process per invocation; wrapper/PHP RSS excluded
